title: Recorded nasal preparation saving with protected source-to-bottle inventory

changes.title: Save confirmed nasal preparation in Stash
changes.detail: The reviewed preparation record opens the exact source vial when needed and transfers recorded mass into a linked nasal bottle using one exclusive, readback-verified inventory transaction.

changes.title: Independently gated preparation-only release
changes.detail: Recorded preparation is enabled; generic preparation transfers and inventory-backed nasal dose administration remain disabled. Missing verified remaining balances are blocked before review.

changes.title: Preserve source IDs, history and stale-tab protection
changes.detail: Exact-source and retrospective known/unknown use checks, failed-write acknowledgement, stale-tab rejection and fictional Chromium Review/Confirm/Save acceptance were added.

dataImpact: No destructive migration or automatic overwrite of existing localStorage, backups, protocols, Check-Ins or dose history. New user-confirmed preparation records debit the selected source vial and credit its linked prepared nasal bottle atomically. Historical prep timestamps and prior-use reconciliation are preserved. An open vial without verifiable remainingMg is rejected rather than inferred.
limitations: Prepared nasal administration/dose logging remains OFF. Generic transfer controls remain OFF.
Nominal concentration and spray arithmetic do not verify actual pump delivery, sterility, compatibility, stability or route suitability.

The production source release v0.9.22-beta was independently verified against merge commit 383c6b7a by Cloudflare parity workflow #41600060574 (16/16 files). Subsequent release-metadata publication requires independent verification.
A physical iPhone LIVE saving test and independent VoiceOver acceptance have not been performed for this candidate.
